LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 8.1.1LISTENING COMPREHENSION: EXPLANATORY NARRATIVES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.1: Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Listening Comprehension: Explanatory Narratives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Listening Comprehension: Explanatory Narratives, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What are the functions of oral narratives?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the characters from a listening text,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Listening Comprehension: Explanatory Narratives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Digital literacy is developed as the learner manipulates digital devices and uses them to create stories and share them with

others

 Communication and collaboration is developed when the learner recognises the value of others as they dramatise dialogues

in explanatory tales.

74

Values:
Patriotism is promoted as the learner listens and responds to explanatory narratives and moral lessons and relating them to their

real life.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Digital citizenship is enhanced as the learner creates an explanatory narrative and shares it through WhatsApp, social media

among others.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate performance of oral narratives to other learning areas such as Creative Arts.
